name: Apples
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of apples both literally and figuratively to convey God’s provision and care. While Genesis 1:29 affirms God's provision of fruit-bearing trees for sustenance, several passages highlight the phrase 'apple of the eye' to describe God's protective and cherished care over His people (Deuteronomy 32:10; Psalms 17:8; Proverbs 7:2). Additionally, Proverbs 25:11 likens well-spoken words to 'apples of gold,' emphasizing the beauty and value of godly wisdom, while Joel 1:12 mourns the withering of the apple tree as a symbol of lost joy among mankind.
